rationale.styleMatch: Bare gray-dark hair and aged face fit the brief; charcoal wrapped tunic, loose cropped trousers, broad crimson sash and sandals preserve restrained Thai-fantasy identity. Removing the rigid projecting crescent restores the intended silhouette.
rationale.readability: Face and hair are clear in front/side/three-quarter views. Broad black/crimson color blocks and open-palmed stance still distinguish the role in the three actual registry gameplay frames.
rationale.technicalUsability: No projecting or floating head accessory remains in idle/talk/walk/chant samples. Body/costume outline stays coherent, with no new visible limb/skin tear or major wardrobe intersection established in these views.

scoreLimits: An 8/10 sampled presentation gate, not complete anatomy/topology, continuous collision, planted feet, grip, seated motion, work mechanics, UI integration or performance certification.

findings.title: Projecting legacy red headband removed through explicit suppression
findings.observation: The raised red crescent is visibly absent in front, side, back and three-quarter idle views, all sampled talk/walk/chant views and registry gameplay. Gray hair follows the native head silhouette; brow, eyes, forehead and profile are unobstructed. No replacement floating strip or new headwear intersection is visible.
findings.provenance: Explicit suppressedAccessories ['headband']; bakedAccessories remains []. This is suppression of a separate legacy prop, not a baked-body accessory claim.
findings.action: No further occultist headband/body changes requested by this bounded review. Parent retains separate final approval.

observations.naturalHands: Open source palms retained. Closeups show faceted low-poly digits and sleeve occlusion; no additional material gameplay defect established. No fist/digit replacement, closed grasp or complete thumb anatomy certification.
observations.gameplay: Three actual registry gameplay images show the isolated small character on a neutral plane; native dark clothes/crimson sash remain readable. They do not establish live-city lighting/UI readability or service functionality.
